purpose: Independent Windows offline verification of the user-supplied backend reconstruction; not hardware, GPU, Npcap or release qualification.

source.note: A new import commit preserves the exact supplied tree, not the archive original commit identity. The initial full run tested that staged import before committing. The focused rerun tested the clean import commit. No production or test changes were needed after either run; this verification report is evidence-only. Windows raw-file source fingerprints differ from the Linux archive because of checkout line endings; the Git tree was verified exactly.
